title: Admin console
overviewIntro: Account access, credentialing, and security activity.
usersIntro: Review account status and manage sign-in access.
auditIntro: Inspect recorded account, application, and profile events.
name: Professional name
signedOutBody: Sign in with an administrator account to open the console.
expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
sessionError: The sign-in service could not be reached.
failed: Records could not be loaded. Try again.
protected: The account cannot be deactivated. Your own account and the last active administrator are protected.
stale: The record changed or moved. Review the refreshed list before acting.
mutationError: The change could not be confirmed. Check the refreshed record before trying again.
deactivateBody: This prevents sign-in and revokes the account’s active sessions.
reactivateBody: This restores sign-in and clears the account’s login lockout.
approveBody: This marks the profile approved and sets the account’s role to astrologer.
suspendBody: This suspends astrologer review access and revokes active sessions.
credentialNote: Verify professional qualifications through your credentialing process before approving an application.
auditNote: Audit entries show event types, time, and limited account references.
